A Bountiful Coffer is found at the end of the four bountiful delves each day if players make it with lives remaining. Open one with a Restored Coffer Key, obtained from world content. It will contain rewards equivalent to the delve tier, starting at Explorer 1 from Tier 4 delves up to Champion 2 from Tier 8 or higher delves. It can contain: * Spec-appropriate equipment * Unlearned curios * Radiant Echo * Undercoin * Resonance Crystals

When opened, it can contain a variety of herbs from , including Tranquility Bloom, Argentleaf, Azeroot, Mana Lily, Sanguithorn, and Nocturnal Lotus. The recipe has a maximum of 2 charges and a cooldown of 18 hours.

Break the Meta (abbreviated as BTM) is a week-long, community-focused Mythic+ esports event hosted by Raider.IO once per PvE season. The competition challenges players to complete high-level Mythic+ dungeons using "off-meta" class and specializations to prove that top-tier content can be cleared without relying on the game's most dominant team compositions.

Brimming Fish Barrel is part of the process to acquire Otto (mount), a secret otter mount. Use the Half-Filled Fish Barrel after fishing up 25x Calamitous Carp from the lava around the Obsidian Citadel to make this item. Then fish up Kingfin, the Wise Whiskerfish by Algeth'ar Academy. Add Kingfin to the brimming barrel to make an Overflowing Fish Barrel.
